descriptor: Tailored travel planning for meaningful journeys

voice.summary: A travel planner who takes the stress away: warm, composed and quietly excited. The tone is of a trusted guide, not a salesperson.
dos: Promise the planning, not the destination
Use calm, active verbs such as explore and travel

taglines: Travel the world without any stress
boilerplate: Cloudlane Airlines plans and flies meaningful journeys for travellers who want a stress-free trip, handling the details so passengers can simply explore.

microcopy.success: Trip request received. We'll plan the rest
microcopy.error: We couldn't save your trip. Try again

logo.note: A plane is the unmistakable symbol for an airline and its journeys.
